item.tib: khro rgyud gsang ba'i bskang ba
item.coloph: bla chen dran pa nam mkhas mdzad/ skabs su bstan pa 'phel grib dus su/ dang ra'i gter du sbas/ yum sras lnga la gter bsrungs (srung) bskos/ phyi rabs las skal ldan dang 'phrad nas kyang / bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i smon lam btab/ dran pa'i spral pa rma ston gyis dngos grub tu gnod (mnos) pa lags so/ des rgyal rigs bru la brgyud nas da lta bdag la dngos grub babs pa lags so//
